isp: Push the heavy parcel with Pac onto WEIGH 2 so the loading gate opens.
After Pac holds STEADY, cross the packing bridge and latch RESCUE to stabilize it and open Pac's dispatch gate.
pac: Help push the heavy parcel onto WEIGH 2 with Isp.
Hold STEADY to reinforce the bridge and open Isp's bridge gate while Isp crosses to RESCUE.
After RESCUE opens Pac's dispatch gate, cross to Pac's matching exit.

common_mistakes.mistake: The team does not keep both heroes pushing the heavy parcel in the same direction, so it does not reach WEIGH 2; alternatively, a hero enters the unstable packing bridge before it is stabilized and falls toward the slime below.
common_mistakes.consequence: Without both pushers the heavy parcel does not advance, so WEIGH 2 and the loading gate remain inactive while the team stays in the safe bay. The unsupported bridge collapses after 0.8 seconds; falling into packing_slime sets the level dead and requires a full level retry, resetting the parcel and pad states.
common_mistakes.recovery: Reposition and push the parcel with both heroes until WEIGH 2 activates. Pac holds STEADY before Isp crosses; Isp latches RESCUE before Pac dispatches. After a slime death, press R and repeat the delivery and pad sequence from the starts. The mistake route is not observed in current44.
